title: React Component Compiler
description: Formal compiler for React components: parse intent → scaffold → implement → test → verify → attest

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract component spec from description: name, props, variants, a11y requirements

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate file structure: component file, index, types, stories stub

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Write full component implementation with design tokens, a11y, variants

pipeline.title: Test
pipeline.description: Write and run unit tests: render, props, variants, a11y, interactions

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Cross-check component against spec, contracts, and IR

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed attestation artifact for the registry

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: component-spec.json exists and has required fields: name, props, variants

gates.title: Export Valid
gates.description: index.ts exports the component as named and default export

gates.title: Design Tokens
gates.description: No hardcoded hex/rgb colors or raw px values — only CSS vars or token references

gates.title: Renders Without Error
gates.description: Component renders in JSDOM with all required props without throwing

gates.title: Accessibility
gates.description: axe-core reports zero violations on rendered component

gates.title: Test Coverage
gates.description: ≥80% line coverage for the component file

gates.title: Props Contract
gates.description: All declared props in spec are present in TypeScript interface with correct types

gates.title: Schema Alignment
gates.description: If schema-artifact.json exists, component data props must align with schema fields. Schema is the source of truth.

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled components

error_codes.RC011: Component props conflict with schema fields
